scope: Same-host TCP. All native cells run five times; every sample retained. Diagnostic captures use separate short budgets and never enter timing results.
goal: portable mean and pooled p50 < fixed C++ independently, and positive reads/writes plus attempts <= C++ independently per process capture.
statistics: mean_ns is the pooled arithmetic mean; displayed ± run SD is sample SD (n-1) across five run means, not a confidence interval. Sample SD and extrema are retained separately.

socket_timings.scope: Instrumented whole-process diagnostics, including bootstrap/warmup/teardown. CPU windows are first-to-last positive IO per thread; read-to-write gaps pair the last read with the next write on that same thread and descriptor. Forwarding gaps may include intervening work on other connections. No instrumented value enters native latency qualification.

cache_simulation.scope: Callgrind cache and branch simulation in separate complete-process runs. Simulated events, not measured hardware counters or native latency; the cache model is recorded on every row. All startup, warmup and teardown included. Cases are targeted diagnostics and do not replace the all-fixture instruction and I/O profiles.

scope_manifest.scope: Diagnostic only; all process startup, warmup, measurement and teardown retained. Instrumented latencies are not qualification.
